description: AGSC-05-27's closed object-property list admits exactly two reachability edges beyond the Link keys: asc:source (from sources[], AGSC-05-14) and asc:review (from verified[], AGSC-05-15), so that a Source or Review fragment IRI is reachable from its item without string-parsing (AGSC-05-23 forbids relying on entailment). Both edges MUST be present when the item carries both a sources[] entry and a verified[] entry. The graph term: every line is a quad whose fourth term is the Bundle IRI `<https://example.org/>` (AGSC-04-15), written as ` <https://example.org/>` before the terminating ` .` of each line; because every line carries the same graph term, the lines are in the byte order of their triples. Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text.
